source_problem_statement: PS2 — Intelligent Ride Matching and Dynamic Driver Allocation System
purpose: Antigravity-ready product, frontend/design, architecture, data, API, algorithm, security, test, deployment and phased build specifications

selected_stack.backend: Node.js runtime via Next.js Route Handlers
selected_stack.demand_model: Python + scikit-learn Gradient Boosting; 15-minute zone buckets and a chosen 30-minute forecast target

advanced_ps2_modules: Predictive demand forecasting with a trained small model
Zone intelligence: simulated surge pricing and driver repositioning
Two-passenger ride pooling and pickup/drop-off route order
Multi-factor driver allocation and fairness explanation
notes: PS2 technology choices are alternatives; the pack deliberately selects one coherent stack rather than combining every alternative.
The PS2 brief requests zone/hour demand history but does not prescribe a numeric forecast horizon; this pack chooses a 30-minute target as an implementation decision.
Driver coordinates, demand history, forecast output, fares and simulation results must be labelled simulated or estimated unless backed by an actual configured data source.
